label: Rivals of the fourteen stage-two attribute premises survive in finite tests
description: Premise-free finite controls for the stage-two premises of the modal spine to STMT-GOD-EXISTS. For each of fourteen premises, one interpretation satisfies its recorded rival together with every other non-logical premise of the premise's smallest verified consuming theorem, and falsifies that theorem's conclusion. So within each consuming theorem the targeted premise is not derivable from the others, and the rival is jointly satisfiable with them. No premise is derived, defended, refuted or closed; no rival is established; compatibility with premises outside the named theorem is not tested. Model claims concern these fourteen interpretations only.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other premise of Round2ExistenceAct.existingInActAtFromSomeAct holds: every existent at the one world is in act in some respect. Its conclusion (every existent is in act in esse) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct predicate and esse respect; one world, one being, two respects.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of the existing rival on the smallest consumer. MODEL-ACT-POTENCY-M2 already witnesses the rival with seven other act/potency premises; the conditional exclusion REL-PERFECTION-REFUTES-ACTUALITY-WITHOUT-BEING (two open premises) is unchanged.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.witness: Control.actualityWithoutBeing in Control.Certificate, first conjunct of controls.
research_comparisons.next_step: Decide whether being in act in a respect presupposes esse without assuming the target (DISAMB-BEING); the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other premise of CausalMapsBatch1.causeOfBeingHasWhatItGives holds: whatever is caused in a thing is had by it. Its conclusion (a cause of being has every perfection it causes) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct and CausesIn predicates and esse respect; two beings, two respects.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated emergence model; not every emergentist account.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the eminent-containment reading of InAct and against STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other four premises of StageTwo.GodIsSupremelyGood.godIsSupremelyGood hold: God is maximal in being, the maximum in a genus causes all in it, actuality only insofar as being, the cause of being causes every perfection. Its conclusion (God is supremely good) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same GoodIn and InAct predicates; one being, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model in which nothing is good; the rival's first conjunct holds vacuously there. Not every fact/value-gap account.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target biconditional on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against STMT-GOOD-IS-DESIRABLE and the desirability account of good; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other two premises of StageTwo.GodIsSimple.godIsSimple hold: God is maximal in being, and a cause of a quality in another is more such. Its conclusion (God is not composite) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Composite and CausesIn predicates and esse respect; one being, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of an uncaused composite God; not every account of brute or necessary composition.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the component route to simplicity (STMT-COMPOSITE-POSTERIOR-TO-COMPONENTS with first being), which does not use the target; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other four premises of FirstMoverSimple.firstMoverSimple hold: no body moves unless moved, the first unmoved mover is the first being, composites are posterior to components, every composite has a component other than itself. Its conclusion fails at the clause that the first mover's esse is not other than its essence.
research_comparisons.scope: Same ComposedOfMatterAndForm and Composite predicates and essenceOf/esseOf maps; two beings, one respect, two principles.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model with no matter-form composites, so the rival's first conjunct holds vacuously there. Not every account of a non-composing distinction.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against STMT-COMPOSITE-HAS-COMPONENT-OTHER-THAN-ITSELF with a typed account of what makes esse and essence components; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other three premises of NecessaryFirstAttributes.attributesFromFirst hold: one actual root is necessary, first and potency-free; composites are posterior to components; every composite has a component other than itself. Its conclusion fails: no actual root is first and a component of nothing.
research_comparisons.scope: Same ComponentOf and PriorSimply relations; one world, two concrete ungrounded beings, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated world-soul model; not every pantheist or panentheist account.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against Aquinas's reasons that a form in a composite is participated and matter is in potency (q.3 a.8), once typed; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other six premises of StageTwo.GodHasIntellect.godHasIntellect hold: God is maximal in being, composites have a uniting cause, a cause is more such, the two kinds of composition compose, no component is first, the maximum in being is first. A material being with intellect exists. The conclusion (God has intellect) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same ComposedOfMatterAndForm, HasIntellect and ComponentOf predicates; two beings, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model with an immaterial God lacking intellect and a material knower; not every physicalist account.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival entails the negation of the target on the identical carrier (it is strictly stronger).
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the perfection route to intellect (PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill), which does not use the target; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other seven premises of StageTwo.GodHasWill.godHasWill hold, including that what is altogether immaterial has intellect. Its conclusion (God has will) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same HasIntellect and HasWill predicates; one being, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of an intellect without will; the motivating necessity-of-nature account is not expressed.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Type the inclination of an intellect to its understood good (q.19 a.1) and test whether it yields will without assuming the target; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other premise of FirstBeingNoPotency.firstBeingNoPotency holds: nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect. Its conclusion (a first being is in potency in no respect) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct, InPotency and PriorSimply predicates; one being, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of the existing rival on the smallest consumer. MODEL-NIGHT-COSMOGONY-RESIDUAL already witnesses the rival with other act/potency premises.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Unchanged from REL-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT-ALTERNATIVE-TO-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY: extend the reduction principle to potencies that are not being actualized; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other premise of FirstBeingNoPotency.firstBeingNoPotency holds: act is simply prior to potency (the being in act prior to the potential being is that being itself). Its conclusion (a first being is in potency in no respect) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct, InPotency and PriorSimply predicates; one being, one respect; PriorSimply is reflexive in this model.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated self-actualizer model on the smallest consumer. The existing conditional exclusion REL-NO-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT-FROM-ANALYSIS-REFUTES (one open premise, the capacity analysis of potency) is unchanged.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Fix one sense of act (formal or virtual) for both premises (DISAMB-IN-ACT) and retest; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other two non-logical premises of WholePowerPerfection.firstMoverPerfectionFromInfinity hold: the first unmoved mover is simple, and what is infinite has every pure perfection. Its conclusion (the first mover has every pure perfection) fails. The theorem's excluded-middle premise is general logic and is not checked.
research_comparisons.scope: Same essenceOf/esseOf maps and Infinite predicate; one being, one respect, one principle, one determination.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of a finite self-existent first mover; the motivating thin view of existence is not expressed.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the limitation-through-reception premises (STMT-PERFECTION-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION) on a shared carrier; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other four premises of StageTwo.GodIsEternal.godIsEternal hold: God is maximal in being, the maximum in being is first, act is simply prior to potency, nothing is in act and potency in the same respect. Its conclusion (God is eternal) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InPotency predicate and primitive Eternal predicate (ETERNAL_1, timeless); one being, one respect. No temporal structure is modelled.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model of a potency-free being that is not eternal; the rival's positive claim of duration in time is not expressed on this carrier.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: State the rival with ETERNAL_2 (unending temporal presence) on a carrier with times and test it against a typed 'time follows motion' premise; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other two premises of NameApplicationTransfer.Description.properDescriptionExcluded hold: the practice's name refers to no being, and proper application is preserved by practice reference. A unique fully described being exists, so the theorem's conclusion (the full description is excluded) fails.
research_comparisons.scope: Same full nominal description and proper-sense predicate; one being, one respect, one name.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model in which nothing is God in the proper sense, so reference preservation holds vacuously. It witnesses the exact negation together with its motivating practice-use thesis; it is not a theory of reference.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Unchanged from REL-PHILLIPS-NO-OBJECT-ALTERNATIVE-TO-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE: test the raw practice-use thesis against a populated proper sense; the premise remains OPEN.

research_comparisons.conditions: Other thirteen non-logical premises of StageTwo.ClassicalAttributes.godHasClassicalAttributes hold, including the five separately supplied attribute conclusions. Its conclusion (whatever is God has the classical attributes) fails. The theorem's excluded-middle premise is general logic and is not checked.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Signature with its primitive HasClassicalAttributes field and the theorem's own nine predicate instances; one being, one respect.
research_comparisons.coverage: One populated model; the primitive field is unconstrained apart from the target, so this shows only that nothing else in the theorem fixes it.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival is the exact negation of the target on the identical carrier.
research_comparisons.next_step: Give the primitive classical-attributes field a definition or a sourced list, so that sufficiency of the nine can be tested and not only stipulated; the premise remains OPEN.
